about: Pending hosts of pipeline/official-sites.json in batches for maintainers' decisions (AGENTS.md section 7.6), with what the host reviewers of run 2026-10-16-hosts-review found about who runs each. Written by tools/pipeline.py hosts --batches; `questions --sync` opens one issue per batch.
